primitives.name: Ranking Polarity Independence
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Ranking uses `trueProb` whenever finite** (including PASS) so overpriced favorites demote; default blend weight 0.7.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\mathcal{R}': 'dimensionless ranking score', '\\text{trueProb}': 'probability in [0, 1]', '\\text{rankingP}': 'probability in [0, 1]', '\\alpha': 'blend weight in [0, 1]'}
primitives.assumptions: Signal probabilities are finite and bounded; rankingP is a proxy for trueProb when trueProb is undefined.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When trueProb is infinite or undefined, fallback to rankingP with reduced weight.

layer2.mapping: Derives ranking score from trueProb and rankingP using weighted average with alpha=0.7.
layer2.telemetry: Signal separation between trueProb and rankingP

primitives.breakdown_regime: When trueProb is missing or invalid, use fallback models.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphism between raw trueProb and calibrated independent signal.
layer2.telemetry: Coverage of independent signal across confidence bins
